name: A Non-Ample Union of Chosen Facet Edges
definition: On $Q_3$, take the union $U=\{000,100\}\cup\{101,111\}\cup\{010,011\}$ of one placed edge for each singleton facet of $\Sigma=\{\varnothing,\{1\},\{2\},\{3\}\}$.
properties: The union has six vertices but shatters every coordinate pair, so $|\operatorname{Sh}(U)|=7>|U|=6$ and $U$ is not ample. It shows why arbitrary placements of one cube per facet need the additional condition that their union shatter no support outside the prescribed down-set.
